g.text: • Hot rows + quota-limited live cold rows; shadows excluded
• Recency selects cold exposure; same count across layers
• Native option: gather selected cold KV from pinned CPU memory
• Use this prepared set in the next model forward

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'Liberation Serif'; text-anchor: start

g.text: • Attend hot + selected live cold + current token
• Produce next-token logits and real attention weights
• Update hot scores and cold access timestamps

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'Liberation Serif'; text-anchor: start

g.text: • Apply promotion budget, re-entry gate and live-cold floor
• Inclusive mode: keep a cold shadow backup
• Exclusive ablation: remove the promoted cold copy

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'Liberation Serif'; text-anchor: start

g.text: a) Admit current-token KV; protect sinks and recent tokens
b) Hot overflow: demote the lowest age-normalized score
Optional write-aware weight favors rows with backups
c) Cold overflow: reclaim shadows, then LRU live rows
Drop permanently; preserve the live floor where feasible
Shadows: reclaim the backup whose hot twin has the highest cumulative score.
Cold storage: GPU by default; pinned CPU option. STT costs are analytical.
Standalone sketch/peek simulation is a separate path; it is not used in this loop.
